options.en: A town that was never built, a place drawn on old maps but abandoned after the gold in Bannack, Montana ran out
options.zh: 一座从未建成的城镇，一个画在旧地图上的地方，却在蒙大拿州班纳克的金子挖光后被遗弃

options.en: A human settlement where people no longer live
options.zh: 人们不再居住的人类聚居地

explain.en: 'Ghost towns are human settlements where people no longer live.'
explain.zh: “鬼镇是的人们不再居住的人类聚居地。”

q.en: In the glossary, what does 'remote' mean?
q.zh: 在词汇表中，“remote”是什么意思？

options.en: Underwater—like the sunken harbor of a fishing village swallowed by the rising sea
options.zh: 在水下的——比如被上涨的海水吞没的渔村沉没港口

explain.en: The glossary defines remote as 'distant or isolated.'
explain.zh: 词汇表将 remote 定义为“遥远的、孤立的”。

q.en: What caused Bannack, Montana, to become a ghost town?
q.zh: 是什么导致蒙大拿州的班纳克变成了鬼镇？

options.en: Gold became hard to find, so people left
options.zh: 金子越来越难找，人们离开了

options.en: A nuclear accident, the kind of disaster that forced the people of Pripyat, Ukraine to leave after 1986
options.zh: 核事故，正是这种灾难迫使乌克兰普里皮亚季的居民在1986年后离开

explain.en: After John White found gold, 'once gold became hard to find, Bannack turned into a ghost town.'
explain.zh: 约翰·怀特发现金子后，“金子一旦难找，班纳克就变成了一座鬼镇。”

q.en: On what date did the volcano on Montserrat erupt, creating a ghost town?
q.zh: 蒙特塞拉特岛的火山是在何时喷发、从而形成鬼镇的？

explain.en: 'In July 1995, the volcano erupted, and it's been erupting ever since.' The capital Plymouth was destroyed.
explain.zh: “1995年7月，火山喷发，并且至今仍在喷发。”首府普利茅斯被摧毁。

q.en: Which town became a ghost town after a 1986 nuclear accident?
q.zh: 哪座城镇是在1986年核事故后变成鬼镇的？

options.zh: 纳米比亚的科尔曼斯科普
宾夕法尼亚州的森特利亚

explain.en: Pripyat, Ukraine, 'was abandoned after a deadly nuclear accident in 1986' at Chernobyl.
explain.zh: 乌克兰的普里皮亚季“在1986年切尔诺贝利致命核事故后被废弃”。

q.en: What do all ghost towns have in common, according to the book?
q.zh: 根据本书，所有鬼镇有何共同点？

options.en: They were all founded in 1923, the very year when the remote island of St. Kilda, off Scotland, finally lost its last residents to a lack of resources
options.zh: 它们都建于1923年，就在那一年，苏格兰外海偏远荒凉的圣基尔达岛，终于因资源匮乏失去了最后一批居民

options.en: They are lonely places where people left due to a threat or lost work
options.zh: 它们都是荒凉之地，人们因受威胁或失去生计而离开

explain.en: 'Residents often leave a town because of some kind of threat or because their work disappeared.' All are 'lonely places with secrets to share.'
explain.zh: “居民常因某种威胁或生计消失而离开。”它们都是“有着秘密可分享的荒凉之地”。

q.en: What is special about Ordos (Kangbashi), China?
q.zh: 中国的鄂尔多斯（康巴什）有什么特别之处？

options.en: It was abandoned after a volcano, the same way the capital Plymouth was destroyed when the volcano on Montserrat erupted in July 1995
options.zh: 它在火山喷发后被废弃，就像1995年7月蒙特塞拉特岛火山喷发、首府普利茅斯被摧毁那样

options.en: It is the world's largest ghost city that was always empty
options.zh: 它是世界上最大的鬼城，且从一开始就空着

options.en: It was built on a cliff

explain.en: 'the world's largest ghost town—actually a ghost city—has always been empty' because it was poorly planned and too expensive.
explain.zh: “世界上最大的鬼镇——其实是一座鬼城——从一开始就是空的”，因为它规划不善、过于昂贵。

q.en: Why did the underground fire start in Centralia, Pennsylvania?
q.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州森特利亚的地下火是如何燃起的？

options.en: Firefighters set fire to a trash dump in 1962 and it spread to old mines
options.zh: 1962年消防员焚烧垃圾场，火势蔓延到旧矿井

options.en: Lightning struck the town, a sudden storm that some say hit the same night the underground fire began spreading through the old mines of Centralia
options.zh: 闪电击中了小镇，一场突如其来的暴风雨，有人说它正好在森特利亚地下火蔓延进旧矿井的那晚袭来

explain.en: 'On May 27, 1962, Firefighters set fire to the town's trash dump... The fire was not put out properly, and it spread into the abandoned mines.'
explain.zh: “1962年5月27日，消防员焚烧镇上的垃圾场……火没有被妥善扑灭，蔓延进了废弃矿井。”

q.en: Which ghost town was abandoned because it was too remote with too few resources?
q.zh: 哪座鬼镇是因为过于偏远、资源太少而被废弃的？

options.zh: 阿根廷的维拉埃佩库恩
南乔治亚岛的格里特维肯

explain.en: St. Kilda is 'a group of small islands 110 miles off the west coast... The islands had too few resources for residents... Life in such a remote place simply became too difficult.'
explain.zh: 圣基尔达是“西海岸外110英里处的一组小岛……岛上资源太少……在如此偏远的地方生活实在太艰难了。”

q.en: What is the author's purpose in writing about ghost towns?
q.zh: 作者写鬼镇的目的是什么？

options.en: To scare readers with ghost stories, filling every chapter with the spooky tales of shadows and memories that the author claims still wander the empty streets
options.zh: 用鬼故事吓唬读者，在每一章都塞满作者声称仍在空街上游荡的阴影与记忆的诡异故事

options.en: To share the stories and reasons behind why these places were abandoned
options.zh: 为了讲述这些地方被废弃的故事与原因

explain.en: 'Learning their stories brings life to places where only shadows and memories may remain.'
explain.zh: “了解它们的故事，为那些只剩阴影与记忆的地方注入生机。”

prompt.en: Create an imaginary ghost town: give it a name and location, and write how it became a ghost town.
prompt.zh: 创造一个虚构的鬼镇：给它起名并设定地点，再写写它是如何变成鬼镇的。

en: Choose a reason from the book (lost resource, disaster, remote location, etc.).
Describe what the empty buildings look like now.
zh: 从书中选一个原因（资源枯竭、灾难、位置偏远等）。
描述如今那些空建筑的样子。
